THE SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICES LONG SERVICE MEDAL

IT is hereby notified that His Excellency the President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Commanderin Chief of the Armed Forces has been pleased to award the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to the personsspecified in the schedule hereto.
By His Excellency’s Command,
Kapila Waidyarathne,P.C.Secretary, Ministry of Defence.
Ministry of Defence,Colombo,24th May, 2018.SCHEDULE
